title: Find if Digit Game Can Be Won
summary: Given an array of positive integers, determine if Alice can select either all single-digit or all double-digit numbers such that their sum exceeds the sum of the remaining numbers.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, determine if Alice can select either all single-digit or all double-digit numbers such that their sum exceeds the sum of the remaining numbers.
constraints: Alice chooses either all one-digit values or all two-digit values.
She wins when her chosen sum is strictly greater than the sum left for Bob.
Return whether Alice has a winning choice.
reference_solution:
def can_alice_win_digit_group_game(nums):
    single=sum(value for value in nums if value<10)
    double=sum(value for value in nums if value>=10)
    return single!=double
known_wrong_solutions:
def can_alice_win_digit_group_game(nums):
    single=sum(value for value in nums if value<10)
    double=sum(value for value in nums if value>=10)
    return single>double
def can_alice_win_digit_group_game(nums):
    single=sum(value for value in nums if value<=10)
    double=sum(value for value in nums if value>=10)
    return single!=double
hints: The two allowed choices partition nums into one-digit and two-digit groups.
Alice can choose the larger group, so she loses only when the sums are equal.
If unequal, the larger group strictly beats the remainder; if equal, neither choice does.
editorial: If unequal, the larger group strictly beats the remainder; if equal, neither choice does.

tests.explanation: The one-digit sum and two-digit sum both equal ten, so neither choice wins.
One-digit values total fifteen, which exceeds fourteen.
